raw_text: Four Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were killed and seven injured when Maoists triggered an improvised explosive device targeting a convoy of the 209 Battalion in the Burha Pahar forest area of Jharkhand's Latehar district early Wednesday morning. The ambush occurred around 5:15 am when the convoy was on a routine area domination patrol. Jharkhand Director General of Police confirmed the casualties and said a massive combing operation involving CRPF, state police, and CoBRA commandos has been launched. The attack is the deadliest LWE incident in Jharkhand this year.
